# Cross-repository coverage vector

`ww-coverage-bounded-summary.json` is the byte-identical Weatherwatch
`fixtures/coverage-bounded-summary.json` golden, generated by the real query
and report consumer for Weatherwatch issue 7. It contains synthetic observations.
SHA-256: `0bee480476e092e2d3cc4bd4f3738344ad94b40229d90a1b3a416f779b42b559`.

Its 300-second interval contains 320 recorded seconds. The wall-clock union is
bounded by 220 and 240 seconds, so exact scalars are null. Both Facts routes
consume this vector through their actual artifact loader and transforms.
The producer test derives the stable fields from real SQLite run pieces;
generation time and freshness are separate from the coverage proposition.
Update both consumers deliberately if the shared contract changes.
